subject.title: fix(qa): avoid touching operator state during private QA runs

question: Should private `openclaw qa` commands permanently bypass the operator-managed proxy bootstrap alongside config and plugin bootstrap?
rationale: The linked bug and PR evidence support a hermetic private-QA boundary, but the protected `maintainer` label requires a human to confirm that bypassing operator proxy policy is the intended lasting contract for live QA flows.

options.title: Approve the isolated QA boundary
options.body: Keep the complete `qa` policy as proposed so private QA never derives startup behavior from operator state.

options.title: Require a QA-owned proxy contract first
options.body: Keep config and plugin isolation but define an explicit QA runtime proxy mechanism before bypassing operator-managed proxy bootstrap.

recommendation.title: Approve the isolated QA boundary
recommendation.body: Keep the complete `qa` policy as proposed so private QA never derives startup behavior from operator state.
